title: Cohort relatedness — aggregated JSON
description: Per-pair relatedness for the active cohort, in the aggregated JSON shape that analysis modules (mendelian.js, mendelian_inheritance.js, lineage inference, manual-review filters) consume directly. Distinct from `relatedness_ngsrelate.schema.json` which describes the raw per-tool TSV; this schema describes the JSON that aggregates one or more tool runs into the canonical {pairs: [...]} shape the atlas pages read from `data/cohort/relatedness.json`. SPEC_registry_v2 §4 replaces the previous empty placeholder.
_layer_doc: Layer key: `cohort_relatedness` (warm tier, preload on page_mount). Path: data/cohort/relatedness.json. schema_status remains 'pending' until a real aggregate file lands at that path — flip to 'validated' to enable resolver-side row validation against this schema. Provisional/owned_by 'population' so the future population atlas can take over without conflict.

pairs.description: Per-pair relatedness rows. Convention: sample_a < sample_b when both are integer indices.

sample_a.description: First sample. Integer index (into cohort_sample_manifest) or canonical sample id (CGA/Ind string).

sample_b.description: Second sample. Same type discipline as sample_a within a given file.

kinship.description: Kinship coefficient (KING-robust convention: ~0.25 PO/FS, ~0.125 2nd, ~0.0625 3rd, ~0 unrelated). Negative values are valid for KING (subtle population structure).

relationship_class.description: Coarse class label. Both degree-based (`1st_degree`, `2nd_degree`, `3rd_degree`) and exact-class (`parent_offspring`, `full_sibling`, …) values are accepted. mendelian.js `_findTrios` matches on `1st_degree`; downstream consumers can use the finer-grained classes when present.

ibs0.description: Proportion of sites IBS=0. Optional aggregate carry-through from ngsRelate.

n_sites.description: Number of variant sites used to compute the kinship estimate.

tool.description: Tool that produced this row (e.g. 'ngsrelate', 'king', 'plink-ibd', 'hap-ibd'). Falls through to layer-level tool default when omitted.

run_id.description: Tool run identifier (e.g. 'broodstock_qc_pass_v1'). Optional carry-through; lets downstream consumers trace which raw run an aggregated pair came from.

samples.description: Optional canonical sample-id list, in cohort_sample_manifest order. When present, integer sample_a / sample_b values index into this array.

schema_version.description: Aggregator-side schema version stamp. Useful when one cohort_relatedness file mixes tools or run-ids.

tool_default.description: Default `tool` for rows whose `tool` field is omitted (e.g. 'ngsrelate').

kinship_thresholds.description: Threshold map used to derive `relationship_class` from `kinship`. Defaults follow Manichaikul et al. 2010 (KING): 1st ≥ 0.177, 2nd ≥ 0.0884, 3rd ≥ 0.0442. Embedding the thresholds in the file lets the aggregator pin them at build time.

_provenance.description: Free-form provenance block — typically carries source tool, run id, sample-set id, and aggregator version. Not analysis-relevant; analysis modules ignore it.
